items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He ran the newspaper and I got to work with him.

ctx.x: Set the type from the case and that‟s quite a little… TAYLOR; That‟s a very specialized job. HINTON; Very specialized job so naturally it had me interested and when I came to… when the [Unintelligible] was displayed, I came in, in junior high and went to this school. I got on the newspaper.
